translations.web: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
translations.bsb: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
translations.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
translations.asv: We must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
